mapper.insert: INSERT INTO just_do_today.notification_setting (member_id, push_endpoint, push_p256dh, push_auth, is_active) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{pushEndpoint}, #{pushP256dh}, #{pushAuth}, '1') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE push_endpoint = #{pushEndpoint}, push_p256dh = #{pushP256dh}, push_auth = #{pushAuth}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO just_do_today.notification_setting (member_id, is_active, notify_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{isActive}, #{notifyTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = #{isActive}, notify_time = #{notifyTime}
mapper.select: SELECT ns.* FROM just_do_today.notification_setting ns WHERE ns.is_active = '1' AND ns.push_endpoint IS NOT NULL AND TIME_FORMAT(ns.notify_time, '%H:%i') = #{currentTime}
